question.instruction: Choose the clues that point to the same thing.

text.label: THE CAMPER VACATION · DAY 4
text.body: Day four of the family camper vacation. It has rained for three of them.

cards.text: The chalk cliff behind the beach, which nobody is allowed to climb.
An ice cream that hit the sidewalk within a minute of being bought.
The town hall clock, which runs slow and which the whole town has agreed to ignore.
The camper’s kettle, which whistles a slightly different note each morning.
The dice from the family board game, which Grandma shakes for far too long.
The mini golf windmill at hole 7, which has eaten four balls.

reveal.title: Every one a face
reveal.explanation: The link: things with a face. The clock’s tells the time, the cliff’s is its steep side, and each side of a dice is one. The windmill was a game too, but it has sails. The ice cream had a short vacation.

cards.why: A cliff has a face: its steep side.
A kettle has a spout and a whistle. No face.
Each side of a dice is a face.
A game like the dice, but a windmill has sails, not faces.
